title: jired watch result
description: What the run changed about who watches which issues

watched.description: How many issues this account now watches that it did not before

failed.description: How many the server refused; the rest were still sent

issues.description: One entry per issue the run sent, in the order it sent them. An issue already in the state asked for is not sent and does not appear

status.description: What this account is now for the issue, or `failed` when the server refused

error.description: Why the server refused; absent unless `status` is `failed`
